# Censio Pitch Deck Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build the 12-slide, 5-minute Censio pitch deck (PPTX + PDF + 30-second demo video) from the team's template, with every number generated by one tested model.

**Architecture:** A Python model computes all numbers into `numbers.json`. A second script turns the licensed template into an empty, re-themed base. A third script builds the slides from `content.py` (copy and notes) plus `numbers.json` and the prototype screenshots. Playwright drives the prototype in demo mode to capture screenshots and the demo video. LibreOffice renders the PDF for visual checks.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3 + python-pptx 1.0.2 + Pillow, pytest, Playwright 1.63 (Node), ffmpeg, LibreOffice `soffice`, `pdftoppm`.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-censio-pitch-deck-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Slides and speaker notes in English. 12 slides, 5:00 total including the 0:30 demo (spec §4 timings).
- Colours only from the prototype tokens (spec §3): brand `#0b5d4b`/`#e6f2ee`/`#7fd1b9`, AI `#a3410a`/`#f79009`/`#fff4e5`, valuer `#5b3cc4`/`#f1edff`, documents `#1849a9`/`#eaf1ff`, ink `#101828`/`#475467`/`#98a2b3`, page `#f2f4f7`, card `#ffffff`, line `#e4e7ec`.
- Fonts: Space Grotesk (headlines), Inter (body).
- Every number on a slide or in the notes comes from `numbers.json` (model) or appendix A of the spec. Assumptions are labelled "est." on the slide.
- Price €2,000 per valuation. A later deal-platform take rate is mentioned as upside only, never in the numbers.
- Team: 4 founders (overhead) + senior valuers + a small platform team, no juniors. Names live only in the gitignored `pitch/build/team.local.json`; the committed `team.example.json` holds roles only.
- Not committed: the licensed template, the built deck files (`pitch/out/`), team names. The repository is public.
- No model identifiers, secrets or personal data in committed files.

## Review Focus

1. Presenter's laptop lacks Space Grotesk/Inter → PowerPoint swaps fonts and text overflows. Expect: every text box has ≥15% width slack measured with the real fonts; README explains install; PDF embeds fonts. (Test in Task 4: `test_text_fits_with_slack`.)
2. The video does not play (Google Slides, PDF, Keynote) → expect a poster frame of the prototype on slide 5 and the MP4 delivered separately. (Task 4: `test_demo_slide_has_video_and_poster`.)
3. Number drift between slides, notes and spec → expect one source. (Task 4: `test_numbers_match_model`.)
4. Notes too long to say in 5 minutes → expect ≤ 2.4 words per second per slide and ≤ 680 words in total. (Task 4: `test_notes_fit_timing`.)
5. Leftover template content (lorem ipsum, "Subtitle here", stock icons) → expect none. (Task 3: `test_base_has_no_slides_or_template_text`; Task 4: `test_no_placeholder_text`.)

---

### Task 1: Numbers model

**Files:**
- Create: `pitch/build/model.py`, `pitch/build/test_model.py`
- Output: `pitch/build/numbers.json` (committed; it holds no personal data)

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `build_numbers() -> dict` and `python3 pitch/build/model.py` writing `numbers.json` with keys `market` (tam_eur, sam_eur, som_2031_eur, income_sales_2024, mfh_sales_2024), `unit` (price, cost_lines dict, gross_margin), `plan` (per year 2027–2031: valuations, revenue, ebitda, gross_margin, headcount_ye, valuers_ye, segment_revenue dict), `team` (valuations_per_senior_2031, classic_valuers_low/high, people_2031), `proceeds` (ask, buckets dict of shares, runway_months_zero_revenue, net_burn_2027_28), `downside` (ebitda_2031, cum_min).

Inputs (from spec appendix B and the user's changes): income-property sales 73,500 (34,700 MFH + 38,800 commercial, 2024); 1.5 valuations per sale; €3,500 mean fee; buy-side share 50%; segment volumes A [100, 450, 1000, 1700, 2400] at [1800, 2000, 2000, 2000, 2000] €/2.0 h, funds [0, 100, 300, 700, 1200] at €1,100/1.0 h, banks [0, 0, 150, 400, 800] at €2,200/3.0 h, commercial+DACH [0, 0, 0, 150, 400] at €3,200/3.5 h; senior €150k for 1,000 review hours; variable €55 per valuation + 3.5% of revenue; founders 4 at [60, 80, 110, 130, 150] k€; seniors year-end [2, 3, 5, 9, 14], average [1.5, 2.5, 4, 7, 11.5]; platform year-end [1, 2, 2, 3, 4], average [1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3.5] at €120k; sales year-end [0, 0, 1, 2, 2], average [0, 0, 0.5, 1.5, 2] at €130k; ops year-end [0, 0, 1, 1, 1], average [0, 0, 0.5, 1, 1] at €110k; non-staff k€ as in the synthesis model (AI/infra 30…200, data 20…120, marketing 40…400, legal 40…150, recruiting 30…140, G&A 40…200, expansion 0, 0, 0, 300, 600). Use of proceeds is grouped by purpose, founders allocated by role: Build (platform + AI/data + Head of AI), Deliver (seniors + PI insurance), Sell (sales + marketing + payments + Heads of BD and Sales), Run (legal, recruiting, office, ops + CEO).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests** in `test_model.py`:
  `test_market` (tam ≈ 385.9e6 ±0.5e6, sam ≈ 60.7e6 ±0.2e6, som_2031 == 4.8e6), `test_unit_economics` (price 2000, cost 425, gross_margin ≈ 0.7875), `test_plan` (revenue 2031 == 9.16e6, ebitda 2029 > 0 and 2028 < 0, headcount_ye == [7, 9, 13, 19, 25]), `test_proceeds` (buckets sum to 1.0 ±0.001, runway_months_zero_revenue ≥ 18, ask 1.5e6 covers net burn + working capital + €40k capex), `test_team` (valuations_per_senior_2031 ≈ 417, classic_valuers 96–168).
- [ ] **Step 2:** `python3 -m pytest pitch/build/test_model.py -q` → FAIL (module missing).
- [ ] **Step 3:** Implement `pitch/build/model.py` (port of the synthesis model with the inputs above; `__main__` writes `numbers.json` and prints the plan table).
- [ ] **Step 4:** Re-run the tests → PASS; run `python3 pitch/build/model.py` → `numbers.json` written.
- [ ] **Step 5:** Commit `pitch/build/model.py test_model.py numbers.json`.

### Task 2: Prototype assets (screenshots + 30-second demo video)

**Files:**
- Create: `pitch/build/capture.mjs`, `pitch/build/test_assets.py`
- Output: `pitch/assets/*.png` (committed; sample data only), `pitch/out/censio-demo-30s.mp4`, `pitch/out/demo-poster.png`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the running prototype (`npm run build && npm run start -- -p 3100`, no API key → demo mode); selectors from `tests/e2e/demo-path.spec.ts` and `tests/e2e/helpers.ts` (`skipOrientation`, `blockMapTiles`).
- Produces: `hero-review.png` (valuer deal review with verdict and "Needs your eye"), `flag-evidence.png` (check 1 expanded with evidence), `revision.png` (revision banner €1,210,000), `ai-at-work.png` (run log), `report.png` (client report), `wizard-documents.png` (5 documents read); all 1440×900 at deviceScaleFactor 2. Video: 1440×900 recording of the demo path, cut and sped to 30 s (±1 s) with ffmpeg, H.264 MP4, plus a poster frame.

### Task 4: Deck builder

**Files:**
- Create: `pitch/build/content.py` (headlines, sub headlines, body copy, speaker notes, sources per slide), `pitch/build/deck.py` (layout primitives and the 12 slide builders), `pitch/build/test_deck.py`, `pitch/build/team.example.json`, `pitch/.gitignore` (`out/`, `build/team.local.json`)
- Output: `pitch/out/Censio-Pitch.pptx`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `numbers.json` (Task 1), `pitch/assets/*.png` + video and poster (Task 2), `base.pptx` + `laptop.png` (Task 3), `team.local.json` if present, else `team.example.json` (list of `{name, role, school}`).
- Produces: `build_deck(base: Path, out: Path) -> None`; `content.SLIDES: list[dict]` with keys `title`, `sub`, `seconds`, `notes`, `sources`.

Layout primitives (one place, reused by every slide): `frame(slide, n, title, sub)` draws the template grid — page `#f2f4f7`, title top-left in Space Grotesk 30 pt ink, the 4-pt green vertical marker left of the title, the short left-edge tick, sub headline Inter 14 pt `#475467`, page number bottom-left Inter 9 pt `#98a2b3`, source line bottom-right Inter 8 pt; `stat(…)` big number + label; `card(…)`; `chip(…)` in AI/valuer colours; native charts via `python-pptx` chart API (stacked columns for revenue by segment, column + line for revenue/EBITDA, doughnut for proceeds) styled with the palette and no gridline clutter.

- [ ] **Step 2:** Run → FAIL.
- [ ] **Step 3:** Write `content.py` (spec §4 copy, updated: team slide = 4 founders + senior valuers + platform team; slide 8 traction = the working prototype; slide 9 mentions the deal platform as a later option; numbers from Task 1, e.g. EBITDA margin 40% in 2031, headcount 25).
- [ ] **Step 4:** Implement `deck.py` with the primitives and slide builders; build the deck.
